sfx_stage_card.wav.note: supplied by the owner on 2026-10-01 as the stage-start cue (committed as sfx_stage_start_v3.wav, renamed to the cue name the code already uses) and bundled AS GIVEN. Provenance, per the owner on 2026-10-01: generated by the owner with ChatGPT. So it is not produced by Tools/build_audio_assets.py, not an extract of the reference recording, and reproducible by nothing in this repository — verified by hash only, and the generator refuses this name. It needed no processing: measured 3.23 s, mono 22050 Hz, −20.8 dBFS RMS, which is the stage-end excerpt's level exactly, with a band balance within ~1 dB of it. The rights decision and its responsibility are the owner's (see rights_review); the four generated candidates it replaces are in git history at commit 1363851.
